title: 良友影音网络规则库

domainRules.note: 演示媒体主机域名，需替换
演示自建 Jellyfin 域名
演示自建 Emby 域名
演示 NAS 管理主机
演示 CDN/远端媒体策略，仅示范

clientExamples.content:
# LiangYou · Surge rules; edit *.example.test before using
DOMAIN-SUFFIX,media.example.test,DIRECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX,jellyfin.example.test,DIRECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX,emby.example.test,DIRECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX,nas.example.test,DIRECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX,cdn.example.test,PROXY
IP-CIDR,10.0.0.0/8,DIRECT,no-resolve
IP-CIDR,172.16.0.0/12,DIRECT,no-resolve
IP-CIDR,192.168.0.0/16,DIRECT,no-resolve

# LiangYou example DIRECT rule-provider; edit demo hosts first
payload:
  - 'DOMAIN-SUFFIX,media.example.test'
  - 'DOMAIN-SUFFIX,jellyfin.example.test'
  - 'DOMAIN-SUFFIX,emby.example.test'
  - 'DOMAIN-SUFFIX,nas.example.test'
  - 'IP-CIDR,10.0.0.0/8,no-resolve'
  - 'IP-CIDR,172.16.0.0/12,no-resolve'
  - 'IP-CIDR,192.168.0.0/16,no-resolve'

# LiangYou example PROXY rule-provider; edit demo hosts first
payload:
  - 'DOMAIN-SUFFIX,cdn.example.test'

# LiangYou: no REJECT rules yet
payload: []

# LiangYou · Quantumult X filter_local; example domains MUST be replaced
[filter_local]
host-suffix,media.example.test,direct
host-suffix,jellyfin.example.test,direct
host-suffix,emby.example.test,direct
host-suffix,nas.example.test,direct
host-suffix,cdn.example.test,proxy
ip-cidr,10.0.0.0/8,direct,no-resolve
ip-cidr,172.16.0.0/12,direct,no-resolve
ip-cidr,192.168.0.0/16,direct,no-resolve

notes: 示例 .example.test 域名不能直接使用，需要替换自有服务器域名
Clash/Mihomo 规则需要在主配置中指定策略组
客户端格式互不等价，使用前应按客户端逐条核对
不含真实节点或未获授权服务器地址
